description: Update the LocalStack seed script to the new versioned PK+SK schema (CODE#TIPO#LANG + sk v#1 & v#ACTIVE) with the 3 GSIs (GSI_tipo, GSI_pantalla, GSI_codigo) and at least one example of each of the 6 types using the design sec.7 JSON examples; refresh the OpenApiConfig/README description to reflect the template-engine purpose. Also create the twin table unchanged. Depends on FEAT-002 (final attribute names + schema) so the seed matches what the adapter reads.
steps: Rewrite src/main/resources/db/dynamodb/seed-templates.sh create-table for notification_templates to a COMPOSITE key: AttributeDefinitions id(S) + sk(S) + tipo(S) + pantalla_destino(S) + codigo(S); KeySchema id=HASH, sk=RANGE; add --global-secondary-indexes GSI_tipo (HASH tipo), GSI_pantalla (HASH pantalla_destino), GSI_codigo (HASH codigo); keep PAY_PER_REQUEST. Keep the findu_notifications table create unchanged.

Replace all put-item calls so each template writes BOTH an immutable version item (sk 'v#1') and a 'v#ACTIVE' pointer item (denormalized copy with the active fields + an activeVersion/version attribute), using the EXACT attribute names the FEAT-002 mapper reads (id, sk, codigo, tipo, language, body_template, variables, version, is_active, audiencia, subject, content_type, wa_template_name, rabbit_*, event_type, title, routing, categoria, pantalla_destino, titulo, cta_*, cerrable, prioridad, vigencia_*, condicion_aparicion, tiempo_desaparicion).

Seed at least one template per type from design sec.7: SMS=VERIFICACION_OTP#SMS#es, EMAIL=OFERTA_RECIBIDA#EMAIL#es, WHATSAPP=OFERTA_RECIBIDA#WHATSAPP#es, EVENTO=PAGO_COMPLETADO#EVENTO#es (with rabbitExchange/rabbitRoutingKey/rabbitQueue/eventType), NOTIFICACION=OFERTA_ACEPTADA#NOTIFICACION#es (with routing condicion/canalSiActivo/canalSiInactivo), ALERTA=VERIFICA_CORREO#ALERTA#es and PROMO_NAVIDAD#ALERTA#es (categoria/pantallaDestino/cta/vigencia/condicionAparicion). Also seed the OTP email template VERIFICACION_EMAIL#EMAIL#es so OTP keeps resolving. Preserve/convert the still-relevant legacy functional templates into the new CODE#TIPO#LANG format (PUSH -> NOTIFICACION).

Update config/OpenApiConfig.java description and CORE/findu-notification-processor/README.md to describe the micro as a dynamic, admin-manageable multi-type (SMS/EMAIL/WHATSAPP/EVENTO/NOTIFICACION/ALERTA) template engine with versioned DynamoDB storage and admin CRUD endpoints.

Validate the shell script syntax with 'bash -n src/main/resources/db/dynamodb/seed-templates.sh' (LocalStack is NOT assumed running, so do not execute put-items against AWS). Then run '.\gradlew.bat build' to confirm the resource change did not break packaging.
acceptance_criteria: seed-templates.sh creates notification_templates with composite key id(HASH)+sk(RANGE) and the three GSIs GSI_tipo, GSI_pantalla, GSI_codigo.
Each seeded template inserts both a 'v#1' item and a 'v#ACTIVE' pointer with attribute names identical to the FEAT-002 mapper.
All 6 types are represented (SMS, EMAIL, WHATSAPP, EVENTO, NOTIFICACION, ALERTA) plus the OTP SMS + EMAIL templates, using design sec.7 content.
'bash -n seed-templates.sh' reports no syntax errors and '.\gradlew.bat build' prints BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
verification: Run 'bash -n src/main/resources/db/dynamodb/seed-templates.sh' (no output = valid) and, from c:\Users\ADMIN\Documents\FIND-U-PROJECT\findu\.worktrees\notif-template-engine\CORE\findu-notification-processor, '.\gradlew.bat build' and confirm BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
findings:
DONE. seed-templates.sh rewritten to the versioned composite-key schema and committed on feature/notif-template-engine.

TABLE notification_templates: KeySchema id(HASH)+sk(RANGE); AttributeDefinitions id(S), sk(S), tipo(S), pantalla_destino(S), codigo(S); GSIs GSI_tipo(HASH tipo), GSI_pantalla(HASH pantalla_destino), GSI_codigo(HASH codigo), all ProjectionType=ALL; billing PAY_PER_REQUEST. findu_notifications create left unchanged.

VERSIONING: a bash helper seed_template() uses jq to emit, per template, BOTH an immutable v#1 item (sk=v#1) and a v#ACTIVE pointer (sk=v#ACTIVE + active_version N=1). Requires 'jq' on PATH at run time (LocalStack not executed here; only bash -n validated).

ATTRIBUTE NAMES match the FEAT-002 mapper/entity EXACTLY (snake_case): id, sk, codigo, tipo, language, channel (legacy), body_template, variables (L<S>), version (N), is_active (BOOL), active_version (N on v#ACTIVE only), audiencia (M: modo/filtros M/userIds L<S>), content_type, subject, wa_template_name, rabbit_exchange, rabbit_routing_key, rabbit_queue, event_type, title, routing (M: condicion/canal_si_activo/canal_si_inactivo), alert_meta (M: categoria/pantalla_destino/titulo/cta_label/cta_action/cerrable BOOL/prioridad N/vigencia_desde/vigencia_hasta/condicion_aparicion/tiempo_desaparicion N). NOTE: ALERTA UI fields live inside the alert_meta map (that is what the mapper reads); ALERTA items ALSO carry a top-level pantalla_destino so the GSI_pantalla key is present (sparse GSI — only ALERTA items have it).

TEMPLATES SEEDED (each v#1 + v#ACTIVE): all 6 types from design §7 — SMS=VERIFICACION_OTP#SMS#es, EMAIL=OFERTA_RECIBIDA#EMAIL#es, WHATSAPP=OFERTA_RECIBIDA#WHATSAPP#es (wa_template_name), EVENTO=PAGO_COMPLETADO#EVENTO#es (rabbit_exchange/rabbit_routing_key/rabbit_queue/event_type=PAYMENT_COMPLETED), NOTIFICACION=OFERTA_ACEPTADA#NOTIFICACION#es (routing isUserActivo->WEBSOCKET/PUSH), ALERTA=VERIFICA_CORREO#ALERTA#es (SEGURIDAD) + PROMO_NAVIDAD#ALERTA#es (INFO+vigencia). OTP: VERIFICACION_OTP#SMS#es + VERIFICACION_EMAIL#EMAIL#es seeded so OTP keeps resolving. Legacy functional templates converted to CODE#TIPO#LANG with PUSH->NOTIFICACION: OFERTA_RECIBIDA (NOTIFICACION/SMS), OFERTA_ACEPTADA#EMAIL, SERVICIO_PROGRAMADO (EMAIL/WHATSAPP), RECUPERAR_PASSWORD (EMAIL/SMS), BIENVENIDA#EMAIL.

OpenApiConfig.java + README.md rewritten to describe the dynamic admin-managed multi-type template engine with versioned DynamoDB storage, GSIs, histórico/rollback and admin CRUD.

VERIFICATION: 'bash -n seed-templates.sh' => exit 0 (no errors; required converting CRLF->LF, file now LF). '.\gradlew.bat build' => BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 18s (tests pass). The non-zero PowerShell exit was only the JVM 'Sharing is only supported for boot loader classes' stderr warning, not a build failure.

OPEN: seed run requires 'jq' available where the script executes; put-items were intentionally NOT run (no LocalStack). .agents/tasks/** and DISENO_MODELO_PLANTILLAS_DINAMICAS.md are not tracked in the worktree, so they are not part of the branch commit.
